title: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
OpenAI [GPT-6 Luna](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#openai-gpt-6-luna) is now available on Unity Gateway. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs pay-per-token](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis#token-foundation-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
